density.summary: 26 shots / 15.3s (102.3/min) · median 0.45s, contrast 50.0x · 111 effect hits (436.7/min, 9 types) · 5 camera moves (2 kinds) · 2 texts (2 animations) · 0 speed ramps · 0 SFX · treated shots 65% · evolution rising · beat data unavailable

deficiencies.directive: Only 26 shot(s) over 15.3s = 102.3 cuts/min; this genre wants 22-55. Split the longest shots at beat boundaries and add roughly 1 more shot(s) — short 0.4-1.2s inserts of a different angle, reaction, or detail from the same footage count.

Only 111 effect hit(s) (436.7/min); this genre runs 12-70/min. Add short (0.15-0.5s) hits with explicit params on the hardest cuts — chromatic-aberration, motion-blur, glow, radial-blur, flash-adjacent grades.

Only 5 camera move(s) across 26 shot(s) (19% of shots move; want ≥60%). Add `cameraMoves` to the remaining shots — slow-push/drift on holds, punch-in on beats, handheld for energy, snap-zoom on the hook.
0 speed ramp(s) (want ≥3). Ramp down into the biggest moment (1.0→0.35 over ~0.4s) and back up out of it, or add a freeze frame on the peak.
0 SFX hit(s) (want ≥4). Layer one-shot hits on the biggest cuts/impacts — they are what makes a cut feel like it landed.
The first 2.0s contains 1 shot(s) (want ≥3). Open cold: 2-3 micro-shots of the strongest footage before the first title, no slow ramp-in.
Only 2 distinct camera move(s); vary them (≥4) so the motion does not feel mechanical.
2 distinct text animation(s); use ≥3 (pop, bounce, slide-up, typewriter, zoom-blur, split, cascade) so the type does not enter the same way every time.
35% of shots carry no effect, camera move, speed ramp, or layout — they read as raw splices. Give every shot at least one treatment (target ≥85%).
